items.source: context - the application context whose environment should be updated; never null
items.translation: context - 需要更新其环境的 Spring 应用上下文；绝不能为 null。

items.source: environment - the environment to update; never null
items.translation: environment - 要更新的环境；永远不为 null

items.source: Property placeholders in resource locations (i.e., ${...}) will be resolved against the Environment.
items.translation: 资源位置中的属性占位符（即${...}）将针对Environment进行解析。

items.source: A ResourcePatternResolver will be used to resolve resource location patterns into multiple resource locations.
items.translation: 将使用一个ResourcePatternResolver 将资源位置模式解析为多个资源位置。

items.source: The name of the MapPropertySource created from inlined properties.
items.translation: 由内联属性创建的MapPropertySource的名称。

items.source: locations - the resource locations of Properties files to add to the environment; potentially empty but never null
items.translation: locations - 要添加到环境的 Properties 文件的资源位置；可能为空但绝不 null

items.source: IllegalStateException - if an error occurs while processing a properties file
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果在处理属性文件时发生错误

items.source: descriptors - the property source descriptors to process; potentially empty but never null
items.translation: descriptors - 要处理的属性源描述符；可能为空，但绝不可能是 null。

items.source: IllegalStateException - if an error occurs while processing the descriptors and registering property sources
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果在处理描述符和注册属性源时发生错误

items.source: inlinedProperties - the inlined properties to add to the environment; potentially empty but never null
items.translation: inlinedProperties - 要添加到环境的内联属性；可能为空，但永远不会为 null。

items.source: Each PropertySource will be created via the configured PropertySourceFactory (or the DefaultPropertySourceFactory if no factory is configured) and added to the PropertySources of the environment with the highest precedence.
items.translation: 每个 `PropertySource` 将通过配置的 `PropertySourceFactory`（如果未配置工厂，则使用 `DefaultPropertySourceFactory`）创建，并以最高优先级添加到环境的 `PropertySources` 中。

items.source: Each properties file will be converted to a ResourcePropertySource that will be added to the PropertySources of the environment with the highest precedence.
items.translation: 每个属性文件将转换为一个 `ResourcePropertySource`，并将其添加到环境中的 `PropertySources` 里，且该环境的优先级最高。

items.source: All key-value pairs will be added to the Environment as a single MapPropertySource with the highest precedence.
items.translation: 所有键值对都将作为具有最高优先级的单个MapPropertySource添加到Environment中。

items.source: For details on the parsing of inlined properties, consult the Javadoc for convertInlinedPropertiesToMap(String...).
items.translation: 有关内联属性解析的详细信息，请参阅convertInlinedPropertiesToMap(String...)的 Javadoc。

items.source: Parsing of the key-value pairs is achieved by converting all supplied strings into virtual properties files in memory and delegating to Properties.load(java.io.Reader) to parse each virtual file.
items.translation: 键值对的解析通过将提供的所有字符串转换为内存中的虚拟属性文件，并委托给Properties.load(java.io.Reader)来解析每个虚拟文件来实现。

items.source: For a full discussion of inlined properties, consult the Javadoc for TestPropertySource.properties().
items.translation: 有关内联属性的完整讨论，请参阅TestPropertySource.properties()的 Javadoc。

items.source: This method delegates to addPropertiesFilesToEnvironment(ConfigurableEnvironment, ResourceLoader, String...).
items.translation: 此方法委托给 addPropertiesFilesToEnvironment(ConfigurableEnvironment, ResourceLoader, String...)。

items.source: This method delegates to addPropertySourcesToEnvironment(ConfigurableEnvironment, ResourceLoader, List).
items.translation: 此方法委托给 addPropertySourcesToEnvironment(ConfigurableEnvironment, ResourceLoader, List)。

items.source: This method simply delegates to addInlinedPropertiesToEnvironment(ConfigurableEnvironment, String[]).
items.translation: 此方法简单地委托给 addInlinedPropertiesToEnvironment(ConfigurableEnvironment, String[])。

items.source: The ordering of property names will be preserved in the returned map, analogous to the order in which the key-value pairs are supplied to this method. This also applies if a single string contains multiple key-value pairs separated by newlines — for example, when supplied by a user via a text block.
items.translation: 属性名称的顺序将在返回的 Map 中得以保留，这与向此方法提供的键值对的顺序相对应。如果单个字符串包含由换行符分隔的多个键值对（例如，通过用户提供的文本块），此规则同样适用。

items.source: Add the Properties files from the given resource locations to the Environment of the supplied context.
items.translation: 添加来自给定资源locations的Properties文件到提供的context的Environment。

items.source: Add the Properties files from the given resource locations to the supplied environment.
items.translation: 添加来自给定资源 `locations` 的 Properties 文件到提供的 environment。

items.source: Add the given inlined properties to the Environment of the supplied context.
items.translation: 将给定的 内联属性 添加到提供的 context 的 Environment。

items.source: Add the given inlined properties (in the form of key-value pairs) to the supplied environment.
items.translation: 将给定的内联属性（以键值对形式）添加到提供的environment中。

items.source: Add property sources for the given descriptors to the Environment of the supplied context.
items.translation: 为提供的 `context` 的 Environment 添加给定 `descriptors`》的属性源。

items.source: Add property sources for the given descriptors to the supplied environment.
items.translation: 为提供的 descriptors 添加属性源到指定的 environment。

items.source: resourceLoader - the ResourceLoader to use to load each resource; never null
items.translation: resourceLoader - 用于加载每个资源的 ResourceLoader；永远不为 null。

items.source: resourceLoader - the ResourceLoader to use to load resources; never null
items.translation: resourceLoader - 用于加载资源的 ResourceLoader；永远不为 null。

items.source: inlinedProperties - the inlined properties to convert; potentially empty but never null
items.translation: inlinedProperties - 要转换的内联属性；可能为空，但绝不会为 null

items.source: IllegalStateException - if a given key-value pair cannot be parsed
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果无法解析给定的键值对

items.source: Sam Brannen, Anatoliy Korovin, Phillip Webb
items.translation: Sam Brannen，Anatoliy Korovin，Phillip Webb

items.source: a new, ordered map containing the converted properties
items.translation: 一个包含已转换属性的新有序映射

items.source: Primarily intended for use within the framework.
items.translation: 主要用于框架内部。

items.source: Convert the supplied inlined properties (in the form of key-value pairs) into a map keyed by property name.
items.translation: 将提供的内联属性（以键值对形式）转换为一个以属性名为键的 Map。
